notes.title: Plaguepunk Justice anniversary
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34365030/0011d8cdc09046e61afc3572422572a371abfaa5.jpg[/img]
When Plaguepunk Justice was released last year, it was designed as a different game than regular zombie games. The heroes in Plaguepunk Justice heal instead of killing. 

One year later, the world is hit by a real plague. Hopefully it is just a coincidence.

Thank you to everyone who played Plaguepunk Justice this year. Be safe and support your medics.

notes.title: Plaguepunk Justice is on sale!
notes.notes:
Halloween is spooky! Zombies are spooky!

[b]Plaguepunk Justice [/b]is on sale this Halloween along with my other games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/787710/Comrades_and_Barons_Solitaire_of_Bloody_1919/]Comrades and Barons: Solitaire of Bloody 1919[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1152420/Heraldry_Studio/]Heraldry Studio[/url]

I have noticed that Plaguepunk Justice has four achievements that nobody has ever got. Even I haven't got them. But you see, I am the developer, I don't need them.

On the other hand, Halloween is the right time for you to get those rare achievements. They are not easy, because you have to actively work to get them.

[b]"Easy Money"[/b] - just create ten bottles of useless serum at the Alchemy table by putting in random parts (one part is enough) and then carry these bottles to the end of the level. Sell them in the shop! The fact that your characters have only five pockets is a mild obstacle - you don't have to do it in one go.

[b]"Master Experimentator"[/b] - you will have to discover a Zombifying serum at the Alchemy table. I will give you a hint - it has three parts. You won't find the serum naturally anywhere, so only experimentation can create it.

[b]"Zombificator"[/b] - after you have created Zombifying serum, you have to use it on three people. Why would you do it? To get the achievement, of course.

[b]"The Hive"[/b] - have 30 zombies in the level. Well this one is easy - you just have to zombify every human in the level, and then patiently wait till enough new zombies wander in, until you have the achievement. Actually, this one might be quite annoying to get.

Have fun!

notes.title: Heraldry Studio announcement + weekly sale of Plaguepunk Justice!
notes.notes:
[b]Heraldry Studio[/b], a software that allows to create different coat of arms, will be released this month! It will come out on 23rd September. HS will be in Early Access for about a year, gradually filling with new features according to the community wishes. 

The link to the Steam store page is here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1152420/Heraldry_Studio/?curator_clanid=34886518

Wishlist and follow!

Meanwhile - [b]Plaguepunk Justice[/b], along with [b]Comrades and Barons: Solitaire of Bloody 1919[/b], are on sale this week. Tell your friends and family!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Wanderers Edition
notes.notes:
Sometimes you don’t know what you need until you have it. Lately it turns out I’ve needed a lot of soothing, which is fortunate because this week’s selection of the best indie games on Steam ranks highly on the alleviometer. We’ve the usual variety you’ve surely come to expect, and a bit less of the drama and thrills than average.

It is time, once more, for some long overdue Unknown Pleasures.

Chilling out, maxing and relaxing all cool this week: plague doctors, Arabian cyberpunks, and… underground goddamn monsters.

notes.title: The release day is set to 25th March
notes.notes:
Plaguepunk Justice, an unusual tactical healing game, will be released on 25th March. 
Previous release was set to 25th February but it is quite clear that even if the game would be completely done by this date, it would not let allow time to work on its marketing. 
Meanwhile the development continues.
